title: Shootings of captured Jews in Lukow
summary: Captured Jews were detained in Lukow, and groups were continuously taken out and shot until Tuesday, 11 November. The excerpt does not state a start date or year.
uncertaintyNote: The start date is inferred from the surrounding transport narrative and is not explicitly repeated here.
